fromTime.description_en: The bootstrap start time in UNIX seconds. It has the same precision as runOnce.fromTime or scheduled.fromTime. Millisecond values greater than or equal to 1e12 are automatically converted. The cursor starts from this time aligned to the grid and catches up window by window.
